<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/workflow_list"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns every workflow in the projects the caller collaborates on, with
live per-workflow and per-node Kafka queue counts and each node's
run-commit pin, for the Monitor page.

This is the stored shape of the grid, polled often. What each workflow is
doing comes from /list_nodes, and what it has done from /workflow_activity.

Workflows are project contents, so projects the caller is not on
contribute nothing here.
